e.title: Cyber Risk Classification (PRC)
e.summary: 网络风险分类统计论文代码（Malavasi/Peters/Trueck/Shevchenko 等）：网络风险分类法分析
e.body: Cyber Risk Classification — PRC 是论文《Cyber Risk Taxonomies: Statistical Analysis of Cybersecurity Risk Classifications》（Malavasi, Peters, Trueck, Shevchenko, Jang, Sofronov）的 R 代码：对网络风险分类法做统计分析——新兴保险风险（网络险）的定价与分类基础。网络风险是精算新前沿（费率厘定、准备金与巨灾类比）。网络风险是新兴险种，定价与分类研究正在形成中。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Cyber Risk Taxonomies 论文（Malavasi 等）R 代码，UNSW Actuarial Software Directory 收录
e.summary_en: R code for the cyber-risk taxonomy statistical-analysis paper (Malavasi/Peters/Trueck/Shevchenko et al.)
e.summary_hk: 網絡風險分類統計論文代碼（Malavasi/Peters/Trueck/Shevchenko 等）：網絡風險分類法分析
e.body_en: Cyber Risk Classification — PRC is the R code of the paper 'Cyber Risk Taxonomies: Statistical Analysis of Cybersecurity Risk Classifications' (Malavasi, Peters, Trueck, Shevchenko, Jang, Sofronov): statistical analysis of cyber-risk taxonomies — the foundation for pricing and classifying the emerging insurance risk of cyber. Cyber risk is a new actuarial frontier (ratemaking, reserving, catastrophe analogies); pricing and classification research is still forming. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]], [[machine-learning-pricing]].
e.body_hk: Cyber Risk Classification — PRC 是論文《Cyber Risk Taxonomies: Statistical Analysis of Cybersecurity Risk Classifications》（Malavasi, Peters, Trueck, Shevchenko, Jang, Sofronov）的 R 代碼：對網絡風險分類法做統計分析——新興保險風險（網絡險）的定價與分類基礎。網絡風險是精算新前沿（費率釐定、準備金與巨災類比），定價與分類研究正在形成中。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。
